requirements.previous_education: SPM with at least FIVE (5) credits including Bahasa Melayu and a Pass in Sejarah. Credit in Bahasa Melayu (Grade C) AND four (4) credits (Grade C) and one (1) Conditional Pass (Grade D) from: English, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Agriculture/Agricultural Science, Science/Additional Science, Geography, Creative Design, Basic Sustainability, Computer Science.
